Deuce was wild, energetic, and chaotic. 
Even Mama thought he was odd. 
When they returned from a hunt, he'd always yell the loudest about being hungry. But once the meat was served, he wouldn't eat a bite. 
They'd call him to hunt, and he'd flop over like he was dead. But the moment the others left, he'd spring up and dash off. Hunt more aggressively than anyone. 
No one understood what went on in his little head. 
Only Deuce knew, he wanted to become the greatest feline actor of all time! 
Those were just rehearsals to hone his acting skills. 
But he'd done the same performances so many times, his family no longer fell for it. 
One day, lost in thought, he wandered beneath a stage. He looked up and saw a human performing love, loss, and every twist of life. 
And suddenly, he knew. That was the stage he had dreamed of all along.
